name: HTV 1
about: HTV 1 (2009-048A), a crewed vehicle (HTV), launched 2009 Sep 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2009 Sep 12), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
